entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane comprising a singular megalopolis in which a vast variety of inhabitants co-exist, once governed by the Guildpact and ten guilds.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical agreement that dictated the law of Ravnica and kept the ten guilds in relative harmony before it was broken in Dissension.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who marches into Ravnica's underbelly in search of powerful magic; protagonist of the novel The Secretist.

events.summary: The Guildpact is broken in Dissension, leaving Ravnica's guilds unbound and struggling for control of the plane.
events.quote: In Dissension , however, the Guildpact had been broken.

events.summary: Jace Beleren marches into the depths of Ravnica's underbelly in search of powerful magic.
events.quote: Jace Beleren marches into the numinous depths of Ravnica's underbelly in search of the promise of powerful magic.
